pe_prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a close-up opens on a ballet dancer's fully extended feet suspended at the absolute peak of a grand jeté, toes pointed to their maximum line, each tendon sharply defined beneath the skin, the instep sculpted with striking anatomical precision like carved marble brought to life. Soft directional light rakes across the feet, accentuating the taut tendons and the elongated curve of the arch, while the background stays softly out of focus in muted, neutral tones. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed, gradually tightening on the instep and pointed toes to reveal finer detail — the flex of the extensor tendons, the taut arch, and a slight tremor of sustained extension. Subtle micro-movements of the feet in suspension convey the fleeting weightlessness of the jump. The camera never tilts down and never follows the descent; the touchdown remains outside the frame, and the clip ends while the feet are still airborne, preserving the suspended, timeless quality of the leap's peak.

overall_soundscape: A hushed studio ambience with faint room tone and the soft, distant whisper of fabric and air displaced by the leap. A subtle breath-like tension holds underneath, with no impact or landing sound ever heard.

non_diegetic_music: Sustained, sparse string harmonics at a very slow tempo, thin and airy, gradually thinning further toward silence as the shot ends.
